lessons.text: Sell players who are injured with no return date (status i) right away rather than waiting; a flagged starter who plays 0 minutes wastes points and the vice-captain slot.
Don't make a doubtful (50%) player the vice-captain or a key starter when a fit, in-form alternative exists.
Prefer nailed 90-minute players over rotation-prone stars (low minutes per game) when choosing similarly priced midfielders.
